texture.scope: Pinned native Body RGBA states; geometry/contact surfaces unchanged

textureEstimate.scope: Texture bindings on the primary actor meshes with visible ancestry, active geometry groups and matching camera layers. Excludes hidden source clothing, peers, room/environment maps, shadow/depth pass textures, skeletons, morph targets, render targets and driver overhead.
textureEstimate.imageBasis: RGBA8 level-zero equivalents per distinct referenced image object. Includes ImageBitmaps and canvases; excludes retained unbound images and internal decode/Canvas overhead. Image IDs are local to this capture.
textureEstimate.allocationBasis: RGBA8 equivalents per Three r187 Texture Source and WebGL upload settings. Includes generated or explicit mip levels, independent of current upload residency. Excludes unsupported texture shapes and sizes. Compressed/other formats are RGBA8 equivalents only.
textureEstimate.webglBasis: Unique WebGL texture handles assigned to the inspected objects by this renderer at capture. Renderer counters cover the whole Three scene. Neither value gives driver allocation bytes.
